title: Tribunal Mode
summary: Distributes Care, Clarity, and Paradox across materially distinct reviewers or model families for the highest-stakes work.
mechanism: The mode is intended to reduce single-model sycophancy and shared failure, but independence must be demonstrated rather than inferred from multiple outputs.
failure_modes: Majority vote over a binding floor
test_status: Concept is specified but under-specified for production deployment and not independently validated.
